propositions: RemoteRef is never constructed in production code; only the frozen dataclass exists, with all construction confined to tests
instance field is undocumented in behavior and derives from configured base URL, normalized by dropping scheme, lowercasing host, dropping default port and trailing slash, and retaining context path
instance does not prevent local-id collision between two same-vendor deployments because _jira_key_to_local_id derives id from Jira key alone, while vendor already separates Cloud from DC
Backend port must declare remote_ref() method returning RemoteRef with instance injected at construction time by build_backend factories, not resolved at call time
both real backends must implement remote_ref() with explicit instance parameter defaulting to empty string, tested against real backend objects with no ambient config
